# `source_flow_bins`

the whole-recording flow of the cortical current per frequency bin (or per sharp group of bins) - a minimum-norm kernel projected onto the cortex's eigenmodes, power, phase currents, Hodge-Dirac flow, optionally cortical band pairs; no wavelets.

Version 1, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run source_flow_bins --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run source_flow_bins --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run source_flow_bins --dataset D --subject S --recording REC --all --kernel KERNEL --cortex per_hemisphere --left LEFT --right RIGHT --columns channels [--bands BANDS --banded true]
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `recording` | field recording, each true, where {"name": "$recording"} | yes |
| `kernel` | operator inverse kernel, from recording.manifold.0, where {"name": "$kernel"} (a free-orientation minimum-norm kernel (`nxr-neuro run inverse` first)) | yes |
| `left` | operator eigenvectors, where {"name": "${left}_eigenvectors"}, when {"cortex": "per_hemisphere"} (the left hemisphere's Hodge-Dirac solve) | yes |
| `right` | operator eigenvectors, where {"name": "${right}_eigenvectors"}, when {"cortex": "per_hemisphere"} (the right hemisphere's Hodge-Dirac solve) | yes |
| `glued` | operator eigenvectors, where {"name": "${glued}_eigenvectors"}, when {"cortex": "glued"} (the glued cortex's Hodge-Dirac solve) | yes |
| `sensor_package` | operator eigenvectors, where {"name": "${sensor_package}_eigenvectors"}, when {"columns": "sensor_coordinates"} (the sensor surface's Hodge-Dirac solve (option A)) | yes |
| `channel_map` | field any, where {"name": "$channel_map"}, when {"columns": "sensor_coordinates"} (the sensor surface's vertex-to-channel map (option A)) | yes |
| `groups` | selection any, where {"name": "$groups"}, when $grouped (sharp groups of bins: a kernel set of boxes on the frequency line (`nxr-neuro run select_kernels --profile box --chart linear`)) | yes |
| `pairs` | selection any, where {"name": "$pairs"}, when {"grouped": true, "banded": true} (grouped and banded: the product groups x bands x bands (`nxr-neuro run select_kernel_product --factors 3`), the band pairs' members) | yes |
| `bands` | selection any, where {"name": "$bands"}, when $banded (the cortical eigenvalue bands, a kernel set (`nxr-neuro run select_kernels --profile cos2_partition`)) | yes |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `recording` | `--recording` | `none` | - |  | the recording's name, or none: every recording of the subject, one run each |
| `kernel` | `--kernel` | none | - |  | the free-orientation minimum-norm kernel's name |
| `cortex` | `--cortex` | `per_hemisphere` | - | per_hemisphere, glued | per_hemisphere (the reference's) \| glued, as source_flow |
| `left` | `--left` | none | - |  | per_hemisphere: the left hemisphere's Hodge-Dirac solve's stem |
| `right` | `--right` | none | - |  | per_hemisphere: the right hemisphere's Hodge-Dirac solve's stem |
| `glued` | `--glued` | none | - |  | glued: the glued cortex's Hodge-Dirac solve's stem |
| `columns` | `--columns` | `channels` | - | sensor_coordinates, channels | channels (option B, the reference's) \| sensor_coordinates (option A), as source_flow |
| `sensor_package` | `--sensor-package` | none | - |  | option A: the sensor surface's Hodge-Dirac solve's stem |
| `channel_map` | `--channel-map` | none | - |  | option A: the sensor surface's vertex-to-channel map's name |
| `groups` | `--groups` | none | - |  | sharp groups of bins by name (with grouped true); null: every bin alone |
| `bands` | `--bands` | none | - |  | the cortical eigenvalue bands by name (with banded true); null: the whole field only |
| `pairs` | `--pairs` | none | - |  | grouped and banded: the product groups x bands x bands by name (the band pairs are measured over its members) |
| `grouped` | `--grouped` | false | - |  | true: the bins grouped by the sharp kernel set named in groups |
| `banded` | `--banded` | false | - |  | true: also every pair of the cortical bands named in bands |
| `overlap_samples` | `--overlap-samples` | `16384` | samples |  | the overlap on each side of a chunk: half a chunk |
| `transform_samples` | `--transform-samples` | `65536` | samples |  | each chunk's one transform: the chunk and its two overlaps |
| `frequency_span` | `--frequency-span` | `[0, 60]` | Hz |  | [lo, hi) the bins kept |
| `name` | `--name` | `{recording}_{kernel}_bins` | - |  | the stem of the stored names |

## Notes from the definition

```text
THE WHOLE-RECORDING SOURCE FLOW, NO WAVELETS (spec docs/specs/2026-11-24-source-flow.md): the flow of the cortical current estimate per frequency bin of the whole recording (the net
quadrature), from the same nodes as `source_flow`: a minimum-norm kernel projected onto the cortex's eigenmodes (options A and B, per hemisphere or glued), the sensor chain's serving,
and signal.cortical_flow with frequency_weighting every_bin (C_k = the sum over the chunks of each chunk's spectrum times its conjugate) or a SHARP set of bins (grouped).
With --bands, every pair of the cortical bands too. No atoms, no time cells.

What it cannot resolve: the net quadrature only (motion that cancels over the run appears as standing); the same estimate as the kernel, in other coordinates (its point spread, depth
bias and field spread inherited); per hemisphere no flow across the midline, glued no medial-wall sources.

  nxr-neuro run source_flow_bins --dataset D --subject S --recording REC --all --kernel KERNEL --cortex per_hemisphere --left LEFT --right RIGHT --columns channels [--bands BANDS --banded true]
```
